body.name: FOBI covariance estimate and Gaussian critical value
body.construction: Let \(\widehat\psi_{m,j}\) be obtained from the Miettinen--Taskinen--Nordhausen--Oja joint FOBI influence function \(\psi_{\mathrm F}(X_j;P_X)\), after applying \(D\ell_W\) and vectorization, by replacing every population whitening matrix, FOBI eigensystem, and moment by its empirical analogue; set \(\widehat\psi_{m,j}=0\) if this plug-in expression is undefined. Set \(\overline\psi_m=m^{-1}\sum_j\widehat\psi_{m,j}\), \(\widehat V_m=m^{-1}\sum_j(\widehat\psi_{m,j}-\overline\psi_m)(\widehat\psi_{m,j}-\overline\psi_m)^{\mathsf T}\), and \(c_{m,1-\alpha}=\inf\{c:\Pr(\|Z_m^*\|_2\leq c\mid X^{(m)})\geq1-\alpha\}\) for \(Z_m^*\mid X^{(m)}\sim N(0,\widehat V_m)\).
